messages:
marta: Heads-up: pasted a param snippet without a "type" -> editor saved and showed a top banner "Schema invalid" with zero pointers. Super confusing.

sam: Oof. We should show an inline marker and let people jump straight to that field.

marta: Repro: new fn -> add param -> paste {"name":"phone"} -> save -> banner. No caret/focus.

kai: We only validate broadly on save to avoid perf hits. Could do a cheap debounced validate of the edited node.

aisha: A11y: banner alone isn't enough for screen readers. Need an assertive announcement with the node path and a focusable "Jump to error" action that receives focus. Announce: "Schema error in parameter 'phone': missing type. Press Enter to jump."

sam: Suggested inline tooltip copy: "Missing field: "type". Click or press Enter to focus this parameter."

kai: Dev plan: 600ms debounce, validate subtree, render inline icon button with aria-label and tabindex, keep banner for fatal/save-level failures.

marta: Run-history follow-up: tool-call outputs are raw blobs. Can we render a compact preview row (first 2 keys + types) with a keyboard-toggle to expand the full tree? Lazy-load the payload on expand.

aisha: Yes. Ensure expand uses aria-expanded/controls and that focus moves into the tree; announce expansion politely. Also check contrast/touch size for inline icons.

design-bot: Created tickets: "playground: inline schema lint + jump", "run-history: compact preview + keyboard". Assigning to @sam/@kai.

marta: Small ask: @sam can you post a tiny mock of the inline marker + run-history preview before Thursday?
